newsitem.title: USA: Mellon buys a Bankers Trust portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Mellon buys a Bankers Trust portfolio.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said Monday its mortgage subsidiary agreed to buy the commmercial servicing portfolio of a Bankers Trust New York Corp unit for an undisclosed sum.
The deal involves a the servicing of a portfolio of 1,843 loans and $7.9 billion in commercial securitized transactions and other special transactions, Mellon said.
Mellon's subsidiary Mellon Mortgage Co agreed to buy the portfolio from Bankers Trust Corporate Trust and Agency Group in Irving, Calif.
